notes.title: Android version ready!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

We have finished an android version of the game and published it to the Google Play Store for free!

You could try it following this link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nbg.mgog1

Enjoy!

notes.title: The sequel of Mosaic: Game of Gods will be soon released!
notes.content:
]Hello, our dear players!

At last, we have finished the publishing process of the second part on Steam.

The game has gone through all the tests and will be released on the 27th of April. In addition to this, we have already lowered the price of the first part of Mosaic: Game of Gods.

You can play the game demo following the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/840240/Mosaic_Game_of_Gods_II/]link[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26683960/d192a4ea3f81c72e54d3ad85b2603b5923e2fec3.jpg[/img]

---
Best regards,
NBG Team!

notes.title: Fixed missing achievements!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

We have a great news! We've fixed the bug with missing achievements, sorry for such a delay.

You need to run the game and you'll receive all missed trophies!

notes.title: Great game from our friends!
notes.content:
Hello dear players!

We want to show you the fantastic game from our friends, Growing Grass Studio!

It's a exciting time-manager game where you should help Princess Aerin to restore the Kingdom and save their parents from captivity of the evil witch. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/593410
